findings.claim: The new guide rows describe the previous behavior in parentheses ('previously ...'), which will go stale in a how-to table and mixes change history into reference documentation. The spec already carries the history in its Previously note, so the guide duplicates it.

The requirement paragraph says 'only a memory with no page of its own can be bridged' but does not state what happens when the memory's own page is in a different project (moved case) and the old-project page's lineage observation also has a page. The ordering between the move rule and the bridge check is left unspecified, so the two scenarios do not cover that combination.

evidence: Diff touches only two documentation files: the memorycard promote guide and the promotion spec.
Guide rows and the spec paragraph are consistent with each other on the two behaviors (own page decides before bridge; moved project supersedes the old page).
No code is changed, so no runtime regression is attributable to this commit; findings are documentation-quality only.
